data.title: File and Directory Discovery
data.summary: The sample enumerates files and directories on the host, typically to locate specific target data (documents, wallets, browser profiles) or to identify an installation path to avoid or target.
data.description:
This is the reconnaissance step that precedes collection or impact: before a ransomware
routine can encrypt documents, or a stealer can exfiltrate them, both need a file listing.
The scope and filters used in the enumeration (extensions included or excluded, paths
skipped) are a direct preview of what the sample is about to do to or with what it finds.
data.recommendation:
* Record the enumeration's filters (extensions, excluded paths) before the sample proceeds; they describe its intended target set precisely.
* Correlate this discovery step with whatever collection or impact routine follows it to scope affected data ahead of time rather than after the fact.
* Note any explicitly excluded paths (its own installation directory, specific system folders) as a self-preservation signal.
data.short_recommendation: Record the enumeration's file-extension filters before the sample proceeds; they preview its intended targets.

mitre_techniques.procedure: Recursively enumerated user document directories filtering for a fixed list of office-document extensions.

mbc_techniques.implementation: Walked user profile directories collecting paths matching a fixed set of targeted file extensions.
